about_the_game:
Turok 2: Rok Match is a deep fan-made rework of the 1999 game build made with Assembly, HEX, C++ and Delphi without having any of the source code or official tools. The goal is to save maximum from original game but make it better, as if done by the original developers.

Enjoy exciting single player adventure and defeat the Primagen or feel the power of lag-free multiplayer deathmatches where even 200+ ping is comfortable to play!

Key features

  • Original Engine!

  • True Widescreen support using the Hor+ method.

  • Optimization. At least a +50% raw fps boost with no synthetic drops.

  • Super smooth stutter-free gameplay, with support for up to 144 FPS.

  • Fixed and improved controls with a modern setup by default.

  • Unlocked internet bandwidth for smoother and more responsive gameplay.

  • Over 50 various critical bugfixes including physics improvements.

  • Extended draw distance, improved tint and restored skies for multiplayer.

  • Eight restored and balanced cut weapons, plus 15 original ones that received bug fixes.

  • Over 50 manually redrawn or improved textures, and over 300 that were properly reconfigured.

  • New Rok Match Mini's Remix map pack.

  • Brand new launcher that makes configuration much easier.

Attention!

The game does not support Carrier-Grade NATs! If your internet provider uses them, you may need to purchase a static IP service from your provider (the best option), get a VPN, or join a free community-supported virtual network in order to access multiplayer game servers.

Also, despite the hundreds of fixes that have been made, the game still has some unresolved issues and imperfections. If you're not ready to encounter them, please choose the original Turok 2: Seeds of Evil Steam release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 1.5+ GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with DirectX 11 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Work on Intel GPU's, Proton and Laptops with dual graphics is not guaranteed!
